**Returns:**

A Hono app to mount (the macts server mounts it at `/references/v1`<!-- -->).

## Remarks

Registers, relative to wherever the returned app is mounted, only `POST /resolve`<!-- -->. The body is a [ResolveReferenceRequest](./api.resolvereferencerequest.md)<!-- -->; `Authorization: Bearer <token>` carries the credential; `X-Request-Id` optionally supplies the correlation id. A body that is not JSON, not an object, lacks a string `app` or a `reference`<!-- -->, or has any other field is answered 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` without calling the runtime.

Success is `200 { result }`<!-- -->: the resolved record for a single reference, an array of records (possibly empty) for a collection reference. Failure is the D6 error envelope with the same statuses and headers as the RPC routes. Any other method or path is a 404 `NOT_FOUND` route miss.

Give this adapter and [createHttpAdapter()](./api.createhttpadapter.md) the same `addressRateLimiter` to limit each client address across both, as the macts server does.
